entry.title: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
entry.note: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Alexander Garden with its stepped granite approach, dark stone tomb, folded bronze banner, helmet, laurel, and the five-point Eternal Flame burner. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
